verdict.rationale: BigQuery's Dataform service is documented as letting users develop, test, version-control, and schedule transformation workflows. It supports Git-based collaboration, and BigQuery release notes say pipelines can be created and managed in Git folders, so versioning is covered and review is implied through Git. Rollback of automations is never explicitly documented, and table time travel concerns data rather than automations, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit rollback or restore of prior automation versions, a documented review/approval workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration, and coverage of AI-native authoring tied to versioned automations.
